50.$description: Page canvas. Saturation is deliberately low at this end — a flat-S ramp makes every neutral surface read as lavender.

200.$description: Body text on brand emphasis canvases (6.3:1).

600.$description: Filled brand zone, dark enough for inverse ink.

700.$description: Secondary text on light surfaces (10.6:1 on brand.50).

canvas-subtle.$description: The docs zone. One step deeper than the page canvas on purpose — the preset points both at brand.50, which left the docs section and the demo section the same colour, so the boundary between two full-bleed zones read as an accidental void.

ink-inverse.$description: Body text on brand emphasis canvases (6.3:1).

ink-inverse-emphasis.$description: High-prominence text on brand emphasis canvases (7.7:1).
